title: StackExchange.Redis
description: A high-performance Redis client library for .NET.

data.text: StackExchange.Redis is the Redis client library used by Stack Overflow. It provides a high-performance, thread-safe, and flexible API for interacting with Redis from .NET applications.

data.title: Basic Usage
data.content: Connect to Redis and perform operations.

terms.definition: The main entry point for interacting with Redis.
Represents a Redis database, providing access to keys and values.

data.title: Best Practice
data.text: Reuse `ConnectionMultiplexer` as a singleton. It is thread-safe and handles connection pooling internally.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: StackExchange.Redis is the fastest Redis client for .NET
data.takeaway: Use StackExchange.Redis for fine-grained control over Redis operations.

data.title: Exercise
data.description: Perform Redis hash and string operations with StackExchange.Redis.
steps: Store and retrieve a string value
